name: claude-usage-monitor
description: Production-ready VS Code extension displaying Claude 5-hour and weekly usage limits and reset times directly in the status bar.

commands.title: Claude Usage: Toggle Status Bar Indicators
Claude Usage: Reset Cache and Refresh
Claude Usage: Sign In / Account Guidance
Claude Usage: Enter OAuth / Session Token Manually

claudeUsage.enable.description: Enable or disable the Claude Usage Monitor extension.

claudeUsage.show5HourUsage.description: Show the 5-hour usage allowance in the VS Code status bar.

claudeUsage.showWeeklyUsage.description: Show the weekly usage allowance in the VS Code status bar.

claudeUsage.refreshInterval.description: Usage refresh interval in seconds (default: 60s, minimum: 15s).

claudeUsage.warningThreshold.description: Remaining percentage threshold below which a warning indicator is displayed.

claudeUsage.criticalThreshold.description: Remaining percentage threshold below which a critical indicator is displayed.

enumDescriptions: Display both consumed and remaining percentages (e.g. 'Claude 5h: 53% used (47% left)')
Display consumed/used usage percentage only (e.g. 'Claude 5h: 53% used')
Display remaining allowance percentage only (e.g. 'Claude 5h: 47% remaining')
claudeUsage.displayMode.description: Choose whether to display both consumed and remaining, consumed only, or remaining only in the status bar.

claudeUsage.showIcon.description: Display the Claude AI logo icon in the status bar.

enumDescriptions: Single compact status bar item combining both 5-hour and weekly limits (e.g. '$(sparkle) 5h: 53%, Wk: 75%')
Separate status bar items for 5-hour and weekly limits
claudeUsage.statusBarLayout.description: Choose between a space-saving single combined status bar item or two separate items.

claudeUsage.autoRefresh.description: Enable automatic periodic background usage refresh.

enumDescriptions: Detailed display with reset time (e.g. 'Claude 5h: 78% (resets in 2h)')

claudeUsage.customCredentialsPath.description: Optional custom file path to Claude Code credentials (.credentials.json).
